Control_description: Positive Control: Analysis functions that use the Positive Control will take the average of all wells defined as Positive Control. Analysis functions only compare sample wells to Positive Control wells of the same plate. Setting up multiple 'Control Region' values in the Plate Layout setup will compare sample wells to average of Positive Control wells of the same Control Region. This is useful when multiple experiments using different controls are setup on the same plate.
Tab_description: View your data as a Heatmap arranged according to your plate layout.

Control_description: Negative Control: Analysis functions that use the Negative Control will take the average of all wells defined as Negative Control. Analysis functions only compare sample wells to Negative Control wells of the same plate. Setting up multiple 'Control Region' values in the Plate Layout setup will compare sample wells to average of Negative Control wells of the same Control Region. This is useful when multiple experiments using different controls are setup on the same plate.
Tab_description: Plot mean data as a grouped bar chart or box plot. For plotting data without grouping, set the 'Group by' field to the same value as the X-axis field, or select a layout definition common to all wells.

Control_description: Uninfected Control: Wells with no intracellular infection, and thus should have no Ch2 fluorescence. When this options is selected, µControl is calculated to be the average of all wells designated "Uninfected Control". Similar to the Positive and Negative Control, analysis functions compare sample wells to the average of all Uninfected Control wells regardless of other Plate Layout definitions for the same plate and of the same Control Region (if multiple Control Regions are defined).
Tab_description: Plot a scatter plot of your data with optional connecting line and optional grouping layout definitions by colour.

Control_description: Uninfected Control by definition: Wells with no intracellular infection, and thus should have no Ch2 fluorescence. When this options is selected, µControl is calculated to be the average of "Uninfected Control" wells that have identical Plate Layout definition fields as the Sample well(s). Samples are compared only to the average of identically defined Uninfected Control wells of the same plate and Control Region.
